Thanks for taking this. We're ready to get Northforge set up as an active vendor in Redwood's payments system. Attached are our completed vendor packet items: W-9 and the bank information authorization form. Summary below:

- Bank: Bank of West (ABA 123456789)

- Preferred payment method: ACH (wire fallback)

Elena — thanks for the packet and the clear mapping. Quick next steps from our side so we can finish vendor activation: 

1) Can you confirm the EIN shown on the W-9 is the same entity that will receive payments? We need a legal match for tax purposes.
2) Please complete the DocuSign authorization for the bank account (I'll send the link in a follow-up). That speeds wire/ACH enrollment.
3) Confirm whether Northforge accepts a 2-line remittance: PO in memo and invoice# in reference. That mapping matches our finance platform but I want explicit sign-off.

Marissa — I looped you to coordinate the micro-deposit verification and to confirm PO-to-remit mapping. Priya — please hold pending Marissa's verification; we may need one-time manual routing for the first payment while NF lands in our vendor portal.

Elena, I'll send the DocuSign link in this thread and note expected timeline: micro-deposits typically appear in 1–2 business days, then Marissa can confirm and we flip the vendor to ACTIVE.

Thanks,
Michael
